name: Joomla With Mariadb
description: Joomla! is the mobile-ready and user-friendly way to build your website. Choose from thousands of features and designs. Joomla! is free and open source.
composeYaml:
services:
  joomla:
    image: 'joomla:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'joomla_data:/var/www/html'
    environment:
      - JOOMLA_DB_HOST=mariadb
      - 'JOOMLA_DB_USER=${JOOMLA_USER}'
      - 'JOOMLA_DB_PASSWORD=${JOOMLA_PASSWORD}'
      - 'JOOMLA_DB_NAME=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-joomla-db}'
    depends_on:
      mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
  mariadb:
    image: 'mariadb:11'
    volumes:
      - 'joomla_mariadb_data:/var/lib/mysql'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-joomla-db}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${JOOMLA_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${JOOMLA_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - healthcheck.sh
        - '--connect'
        - '--innodb_initialized'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
